Maria (CSM): Heads-up — prepping quarterly engagement for AtlasOps (QBR next Thu 10am PT). Need slide owners, demo run order, and a short exec readout (3 bullets). Who can take what?
James (Account Exec): I can own the renewal/risk slide. Quick Q — any new renewal signals since last check?
Maria (CSM): @James saw an uptick in usage but a support spike last week. I logged it in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/atlasops-qbr (owners & notes).
Sanjay (Solutions Eng): I can take the demo infra slide and do the live demo if env is stable. Need a clean sandbox token + a short script.
Emily (Product): Can draft the product roadmap blurb + 1 prioritized ask for exec (feature + success metric). ETA EOD tomorrow.
Maria (CSM): Great. Sanjay — can you paste the minimal demo commands here so we can sanity-check with support?
Sanjay (Solutions Eng): Copy/paste for demo run (use sandbox):
```bash
export REDWOOD_KEY=sandbox-xxxx
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"AtlasOps summary demo"}'
```
Use --stream for live output; sessions will be ephemeral. I'll provision tokens for the rehearsal.
James (Account Exec): I'll add the renewal ask + health radar. Maria — can you add recent NPS comment snippets to the slides? Short quotes only.
Maria (CSM): Done. Also added a one-slide risk mitigation plan (fallback model + canary route). Please review.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: QBR rehearsal — AtlasOps — Tue 9am PT; invite sent to participants.
Emily (Product): Quick ask — can we include a 30s screenshot of the new latency dashboard? I can drop one in the deck.
Sanjay (Solutions Eng): Heads-up: test dataset has a prompt that triggers longer sequences; recommend we pin sequence length to 512 in demo config: `max_tokens:512`.
Maria (CSM): Action items recap: 1) @James — renewal/risk slide + 2 bullets (due tomorrow) 2) @Sanjay — demo script + sandbox tokens (provisioned by EOD) 3) @Emily — product ask + screenshot (due tomorrow) 4) @Maria — exec readout + NPS quotes + handoff deck. Rehearsal Tue 9am PT. Reply here with blockers. :thumbsup:
James (Account Exec): Ack, will finish my slide by 5pm tomorrow.
Sanjay (Solutions Eng): Provisioning tokens now, will post creds in #secret-demo-creds and ping here when done.
Emily (Product): On track. Will upload screenshot to the deck.
Maria (CSM): If no blockers, I'll run a 15m exec dry-run Mon 4pm for alignment (optional). Please react if you can make it. :raised_hands: 
James (Account Exec): Can do Mon 4pm.
Sanjay (Solutions Eng): +1
Emily (Product): +1
Maria (CSM): Thanks all — closing thread for updates, will post deck link when slides consolidated.
